title: Life Planning: Your Future, Your Path
text: Explore how your life might develop over time and design a personal plan that reflects your goals, responsibilities, and future ambitions.
cdi_links: 4.B.05 Considering how they want to move through different life stages and manage different life roles

title: Introduction
text: In this lesson, you will explore
bullets: How life stages influence priorities and decisions
The different roles people take on throughout life
How to create a long-term personal life plan

title: Success Criteria
bullets: I can design a long-term life plan that reflects my future goals
I can identify how priorities may change at different life stages
I can explain how adaptability helps people manage change

title: Key Words
bullets: Life Planning – Thinking ahead to organise future goals and responsibilities
Adaptability – The ability to adjust to new situations or changes
Lifestyle Goals – Aspirations for how a person wants to live their life

title: Quick Questions
text: What are two goals you currently have for your future?
Do you think people’s priorities stay the same throughout life?

title: What Is Life Planning?
bullets: Life planning involves thinking about what you want your future to look like
It includes decisions about education, careers, relationships, and where you live
Planning ahead gives direction and supports better decision-making
Plans should evolve as your life changes

title: Life Stages and Changing Priorities
bullets: Early adulthood may focus on education, training, or starting a career
Midlife may involve career progression and family responsibilities
Later life may focus on retirement, wellbeing, and personal interests
Priorities naturally change over time

title: Different Life Roles
bullets: People take on roles such as employee, student, parent, or carer
Roles can change depending on circumstances
Balancing multiple roles can be challenging
Priorities shift depending on responsibilities

title: The Importance of Adaptability
bullets: Life does not always go as planned
Adaptability means being open to change
It involves adjusting plans when needed
Staying positive helps build resilience

title: Complete the sentence
sentence: Adaptability helps people manage ______ and unexpected ______

title: Key Takeaways
text: Life planning helps provide direction for your future
Priorities change across different life stages
Adaptability is key to managing challenges and change
